evidence: The paper uses GWAS-based ranking ("we ranked the SNPs according to the strength of their association with the phenotype as determined by a GWAS") combined with random forest prediction. Validation relies on held-out test data: "Finally, we employed the trained model to predict the phenotypes of the Ψ dataset and calculated the R² value between predicted and true phenotypes." The paper does not use tree-based variable importance measures for feature selection or interpretation of results.
